properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional chart title rendered above the plot.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Optional sub-title rendered under the title in the muted text colour.

properties.name: markLines
properties.description: Vertical reference lines across the plot (e.g. a "current time" divider).

properties.name: titleAlign
properties.description: Title alignment over the plot: `start` (left), `center`, or `end` (right).

properties.name: series
properties.description:
Series array. Each entry is one line. Empty → empty state.

`data` is either a bare list of y values, positioned by index against
`xAxis.data`, or a list of points carrying their own x —
`{ x: '2021-11-13', y: 0.12 }` / `['2021-11-13', 0.12]`. Points are what
irregular data needs: uneven sampling, or several series measured on
completely different dates. Set `xAxis.scale = 'time'` (or `'value'`) so
the gaps render proportionally; series carrying their own x need no
`xAxis.data` at all.

properties.name: xAxis
properties.description: X-axis configuration.

properties.name: yAxis
properties.description: Y-axis configuration.

properties.name: yAxes
properties.description:
Multiple independent value (y) axes. When set (non-empty), each series is
measured against `yAxes[series.yAxisIndex ?? 0]`, and the axes stack outward
from the plot (first → left, rest → right, or per each axis' `position`).
Supersedes the single `yAxis`. Each axis keeps its own `min`/`max`/`scale`/
`valueFormatter`/`label`.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: Default curve interpolation. Overridable per-series.

properties.name: stack
properties.description: Stacking strategy.

properties.name: connectNulls
properties.description: Whether `null` values are bridged with a straight line.

properties.name: showMarks
properties.description: Show data-point markers on every series by default.

properties.name: lineWidth
properties.description:
Line stroke width in px, for every series. Default 2.5; a per-series
`series[].lineWidth` overrides it.

properties.name: markSize
properties.description:
Marker RADIUS in px, for every series. Overrides the per-symbol default; a
per-series `series[].markSize` wins.

properties.name: area
properties.description: Render the line area as a filled gradient below the line.

properties.name: showLine
properties.description:
Draw the line for each series. Default `true`. Set `false` for a fill-only
chart (with `area`) or a marks-only chart — handy when a high `fillOpacity`
makes the same-coloured line vanish into the fill. A per-series
`series[].stroke` still wins over this.

properties.name: legend
properties.description: Legend position. `'none'` hides the legend.

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description: Tooltip interaction model.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: Gridlines: horizontal (y ticks), vertical (x ticks), both, or none.

properties.name: axisTicks
properties.description: Draw small perpendicular tick marks on the axes.

properties.name: inverted
properties.description:
Transpose the axes — the x-axis data runs vertically and the values run
horizontally (e.g. a temperature-by-altitude spline). Best with `curve="smooth"`.

properties.name: showLabels
properties.description: Print each point's value as a data label beside its marker.

properties.name: seriesLabels
properties.description: Label each series at its last point with its name (follows the line end).

properties.name: zoom
properties.description:
Interactive zoom over the x range.
  • `inside` — drag horizontally across the plot to zoom into that span;
    double-click anywhere in the plot to reset.
  • `slider` — an `md-slider` in range mode under the plot: drag either
    thumb to resize the window, click the track to jump the nearest thumb,
    drag the window itself to pan. Thumbs are focusable and take
    Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown.
  • `both` — both of the above.

Zoom is a *view* over the data: `series`/`xAxis` are untouched, and
`mdHover`/`mdMarkerClick` keep reporting absolute indices into your data.

properties.name: locale
properties.description:
BCP-47 locale for the DEFAULT number / date formatting — axis ticks,
tooltip values and the screen-reader table. Empty follows the browser.
An explicit `valueFormatter` / `xAxis.valueFormatter` always wins, so a
consumer that formats its own values is unaffected.

properties.name: labelEmpty
properties.description:
Text shown when there is no data. The `empty` slot still overrides it —
this is the prop form, for handing a string straight from a dictionary.

properties.name: labelPlot
properties.default: 'Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.'
properties.defaultValue: Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.
properties.description:
Instructions announced when the plot receives keyboard focus. The plot is
focusable so a keyboard user can walk the data with the arrow keys; this
is what tells them so.

properties.name: labelPoint
properties.description:
Template for the live announcement made as keyboard focus moves. `%x%` is
the axis value and `%values%` the series readings at it.

properties.name: labelZoomStart
properties.description: Accessible label for the zoom slider's start thumb.

properties.name: labelZoomEnd
properties.description: Accessible label for the zoom slider's end thumb.

properties.name: summary
properties.description:
Replaces the generated `aria-label` outright. The default summary is
assembled in English ("Revenue, Line chart, with 2 series, from Jan to
Dec."); rather than translate it piecewise, hand over the whole sentence
built in your own language.

properties.name: tableLabels
properties.type: { x?: string; index?: string; series?: string; truncated?: string }
properties.description:
Translatable chrome for the screen-reader data table. `%shown%` and
`%total%` are substituted in `truncated`.

properties.name: valueFormatter
properties.description:
Format raw Y values for tooltips / a11y table.

The tooltip also asks it about series with NO value at the hovered x —
`null` when the series has a null datum there, `undefined` when it has no
datum at all. Return `''` (or leave those cases unhandled) to keep the
default behaviour of omitting the series; return a string to show a row
for it — e.g. `(v) => (v === null ? 'no reading' : v === undefined ? '—' : v + ' m')`.

properties.name: tooltipRenderer
properties.description:
Replace the tooltip's content with your own. Receives everything the chart
knows about the hovered x — the axis value + its formatted label, and per
visible series the index, label, colour, raw and formatted value, and
whether it is the emphasised one — split into `series` (has a reading here)
and `missing` (does not).

Return a DOM `Node` (what React / Vue / Angular renderers produce), a
string (inserted as TEXT, never parsed as markup), `{ unsafeHtml }` to opt
into raw HTML, `undefined` to fall back to the built-in tooltip, or `null`
for no tooltip at this x. The engine keeps positioning it, and it is still
the `tooltip` CSS part.

properties.name: heightProp
properties.description: Force a specific height (CSS length).

properties.name: noAnimation
properties.description: Disable all animation (shorthand for `animation="none"`).

properties.name: animation
properties.description: Entry-animation variant: `expressive` (default), `grow`, `fade`, `draw`, or `none`.

properties.name: animationDuration
properties.description: Entry-animation duration override in ms (≤ 0 disables).

properties.name: loading
properties.description:
Data is still on its way — the chart covers the plot with a loader instead
of drawing an empty (or stale) axis, and marks itself `aria-busy`.

Set it while the fetch is in flight and clear it when `series` arrives; the
entry animation replays on the way out, so the data draws itself in rather
than appearing fully formed. Slot `loading` to replace the default
indicator with your own skeleton.

properties.name: loadingLabel
properties.description: Accessible + visible text under the loader.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

events.name: mdLegendClick
events.detail: { seriesIndex: number; seriesId?: string; selected: boolean }

events.name: mdZoom
events.detail: { startIndex: number; endIndex: number; reset: boolean }

cssProperties.name: --md-line-chart-zoom-size

cssProperties.name: --md-line-chart-zoom-handle-color
cssProperties.description: Zoom slider thumb + drag-band edge colour

Native layout measurement must replace ResizeObserver.
getBoundingClientRect depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
Computed CSS must become native theme/layout values.
querySelector depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
shadowRoot depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
DOM cancellation, bubbling and composed paths are not implied by a native callback.

name: Line Chart
description: A trend over a continuous axis. One or many series, six curve types, multiple y-axes, mark lines, drag-zoom and a slider band, plus a built-in loading state.

notes: Native Canvas plots. Supports scalar/y/value points and gaps; linear curves, unstacked single-axis. Tap probes first visible series. JS formatters, zoom, marks, multi-axis, stack, smooth curves and exact pointer event metadata remain unsupported.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, form association, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
Native Canvas baseline: index-based linear plotting and simple hit selection. Advanced scales, curves, stacking, zoom, exact source tooltip/hit-test/event payload parity remain incomplete.
